note: Fuel runs (Abe, 2026-09-26): someone is short on fuel for a reason, and something happens if it does not arrive. A fuel run is a delivery of fuel from the captain's own tank (DELIVER_ORE with ore_type "fuel"). One group, one reason and one stake are drawn per posting; the title comes from the group. Neutral wording, no numbers in the text (the game adds the amount).

groups.title: Survey Crew Stranded
groups.who: a survey crew out on the edge of the belt

groups.title: Convoy Short of Fuel
groups.who: a refugee convoy waiting at the gate

groups.title: Relay Keepers Low on Fuel
groups.who: the crew keeping the comms relay running

reasons: their refinery cracked a feed line
the tanker that was due never arrived
someone sold their reserve out from under them
a leak drained half the tanks overnight
prices spiked and the budget ran out
their own ice run came back empty

stakes.text: the clinic goes dark and the patients on life support go with it
their ship drifts into the belt with nobody at the helm
the convoy misses its window and is left behind when the lane closes
nobody answers the next raider call
the co-op sells its claims to whoever is waiting to buy them cheap
the relay goes quiet and half the system loses its news
they lose the only thing they had left to bargain with

block_runs.note: Fuel Blocks for station generators (item fuel_booster): made in this system from water ice, never jumped in. Where the belts have no ice, the ice has to be hauled in from outside.

groups.title: Dock Cranes Running Dry
groups.who: the loading cranes on the docks

reasons: the last shipment of blocks was sold off-station
a fire took out the block store
the fabricator's been down for a week
demand doubled when the shift rota changed

stakes.text: the next power dip takes the air recyclers with it
a whole ring goes cold overnight
cargo sits on the pads and the traders move on
people here go without, and remember who could have helped
